scientific_limitations: Complex Segre varieties and boundary-format hyperdeterminants only.
The Stirling enumeration is for parity and treats tensor formats up to permutation of the smaller factors.
For odd primes the exact valuation law is proved, but no closed enumeration of all carry-free formats is claimed.
The arithmetic classification is a consequence of the classical boundary degree formula plus valuation and carry arguments, so an unindexed source may contain the same consequence.
title: Carry-free parity classification for boundary-format hyperdeterminants
